section_summary.extract_value: This procedures section describes two distinct studies: Study 1 (main study) conducted between January-March 2017 where participants completed an anonymous paper-and-pencil questionnaire on campus, and Study 2 (test-retest study) conducted in June 2017 where a separate sample completed the BAS-2 twice with a three-week interval. Both studies involved voluntary participation from university campus locations with written informed consent and debrief procedures.
